purpose: Identify response headers that leak implementation detail (framework, versions, internal paths/hosts) useful to an attacker.
when_to_use: Baseline check on any authorized web application (risk 1, passive). Complements the missing-security-headers check: that one flags absent protections, this one flags present-but-leaky headers.
detection_approach: Fetch the target and compare response headers against a configured watch-list (X-Powered-By, Server with version, X-AspNet(-Mvc)-Version, X-Recruiting, Via, X-Backend-Server). Report the leaky headers actually present.

references.title: OWASP HTTP Security Headers Cheat Sheet
